name: Harley-Davidson Softail (Milwaukee-Eight)
engine: Milwaukee-Eight 107 or 114 V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: The 2018-on Softail frame with the Milwaukee-Eight. Check the rear shock adjuster recall first.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2018-2024 Softails (Heritage, Low Rider S and ST, Deluxe and others) are in recall 25V375. The rear shock preload adjuster bracket can break and puncture the rear tire. Bikes fixed under the earlier recall 23V591 need the new fix too.
A-002.reason: A sudden flat rear tire can cause a crash. The repair is free and quick.

recalls.what: Rear shock preload adjuster bracket can break and puncture the rear tire.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a new bracket free (Harley recall 0188).
